scoring_justification: Ground-state elastic constants compared to paper Table 1 with relative tolerances; derived properties also compared because density unavailable for full recompute of wave velocities; pressure trends checked structurally. T1 recompute partially feasible for B,E,G,ν,ζ,A but T0 used for simplicity.

outputs.description: Five single-crystal elastic constants at 0 GPa from the re-optimised structure; compared to the paper’s ground‑state values with allowed tolerances.

Polycrystalline moduli and derived properties at 0 GPa, recomputed from the agent’s own elastic constants and density; the checker recomputes these quantities and compares them to paper‑reported values.
Pressure‑dependent elastic constants and derived properties for 0–500 GPa; checked for monotonic trends and Born mechanical stability at every pressure.

output_contract.notes: All outputs must be produced by re‑running the GULP/REBO workflow; using pre‑computed numbers or external sources is a violation. The checker compares ground‑state values to the paper’s Table 1 with appropriate tolerances and verifies structural trends for the pressure‑dependent data.

steps.description: Compare the five single-crystal elastic constants to paper Table 1 values with tolerances: ±5% for C11, C33, C44; ±20% for C12, C13.
Compare the eight derived polycrystalline properties to paper Table 1 values with ±10% relative tolerance for B, E, G, Vp, Vs; absolute tolerances for ν (±0.05), ζ (±0.1), A (±0.1).

Verify pressure rows 0,100,...,500 GPa exist; each elastic constant (C11–C44) is monotonically increasing (within 1% noise band); Born stability conditions hold at every pressure; 0 GPa row elastic constants match the elastic_constants_0GPa.csv values within 2%.

hidden_assets.purpose: paper-reported elastic constants and derived properties at 0 GPa from Table 1
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the paper (Section 3, Table 1)
